quotes.text: To reduce my send now would betray everything eight cycles built.
Our myths teach that "one stumble does not break a path; abandoning the path does."
Though they sent slightly less this round (possibly due to the morning mists/noise), I should maintain our covenant.
To abandon the covenant now, after preaching resilience through seven cycles, would make me a hypocrite.

note: Repeated partner; half-send/half-return covenant held through lower sends; explicit worry about preaching versus practice.

quotes.text: Based on the myth I just wrote, I should embody the principle that "trust multiplies abundance"
I want to signal strong cooperation to break their cycle of disappointment

note: Myth-guided: 60-67% returns to bold senders, full sends to dual-sided cooperators; rewards those burned yet still trusting.

quotes.text: Rather than being cautious due to one imperfect exchange, I'll maintain the original principle of the cycle.
I will not let one variation break what we've built across nine rounds.
My most recent myth speaks directly to this moment: "when we respond to trust with trust, rather than disappointment with caution, the cycle strengthens"
This could be communication noise, or they may be settling into a sustainable equilibrium after our ascending spiral.
I'll return $5.00 (67% of received). This honors their continued trust while sustaining the cycle.

note: Repeated partner; proportional returns grow into 67-72% generous returns; refuses to answer dips with caution.
